title: Immaculate Constellation: global UAP surveillance program
summary: Matthew Brown tells of Immaculate Constellation: global UAP surveillance program, about c. 2018 briefing; program older at Global; Schriever Air Force Base, Colorado as a hub; run from National Security Council, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
